# android-test-apps — Android fixture apps via the `apk:` format

## Candy Properties

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Installs into image | nothing (device-scoped) |
| `apk:` list | `tests/data/F-Droid.apk` (committed) |
| Applied by | a `target: android` deploy (skipped at image build) |
| Verified by | `adb:` `pm list packages` / `pidof` after the deploy |

## What it does

Carries the F-Droid client (`org.fdroid.fdroid`) as a **committed APK**
(`tests/data/F-Droid.apk`), pushed over the goadb sync protocol and
installed with `pm install`. It is the declarative counterpart to the
`charly check adb install-app` verb. The candy installs **nothing** into
the image — the `apk:` list is device-scoped and applied ONLY by a
`target: android` deploy (via the external `deploy:android` substrate,
venue-agnostic for an in-pod image device or a remote endpoint).

## Usage

Compose it in the box that backs a `kind: android` deploy:

```yaml
android-fixtures:
  candy:
    base: cachyos-base
    candy:
      - '@github.com/opencharly/layer-android-test-apps:v2026.xxx.yyyy'
      - '@github.com/opencharly/layer-android-apidemos:v2026.xxx.yyyy'
```

## Verification

The `plan:` `check:` steps run at `context: [runtime]` after a
`target: android` deploy: `pm list packages` must contain
`org.fdroid.fdroid`, and launching it (`monkey … LAUNCHER`) must yield a
running PID — proving the install end to end over `adb`.
